title: UNDERBODY-SEAT & SEAT BELT MOUNTING ATTACHMENTS
summary: Floor pan (underbody) hardware for the seats and seat belts: the front seat mounting reinforcements (seat track mounting strips, LH/RH), the rear seat anchor plates, the inner seat belt mounting plate on the tunnel, and floor hole plugs. All are riveted to the fiberglass floor, holes drilled using the parts as templates; the inner belt plate area gets 57b cement.

parts.name: PLATE ASM-INNER SEAT BELT MTG.
parts.name_expanded: Plate assembly – inner seat belt mounting (tunnel)

materials.where: inner seat belt mounting plate [7] / rear anchor plate [6] at the tunnel

fastening.note: Rivets [2] go down through the floor into the front seat mounting reinforcement [1] along its length; a rivet [3] at the rear end. Seat bolt holes 27/64 dia (4 places) drilled using [1] as template.

fastening.to: floor pan at rear of seat
fastening.note: Rivets [4] (and [2] on the inboard pad) go down through raised pads in the floor into rear anchor plates [6] underneath.
Inner seat belt mounting plate [7] riveted at its feet; .192/.199 dia holes (12 places) drilled using the plate as template. 57b cement at the plate.
57b cement where plate [7] meets the anchor plate [6] area.
Plugs [8] push into holes in the floor pan (3 shown).
Plug [12] pushes into a hole near the tunnel (shown at right).
